description: This file defines a Directory class for representing and manipulating a file structure hierarchy, including methods for adding files, checking for files, and generating a string representation of the directory tree. It also includes a function to create a Directory object from a list of files with pattern matching.

classes.name: Directory
classes.description: Represents a directory node in a file structure hierarchy, with methods for managing child directories and files, and for generating a print-friendly tree view.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes a Directory object with a name, directory flag, and an empty children dictionary.

methods.name: _get_dir
methods.description: Builds and returns the Directory path specified by a list of directory names.

methods.name: _add_file
methods.description: Adds a file to the directory structure at the specified path.

methods.name: has_file
methods.description: Checks if a file exists within the directory hierarchy.

methods.name: __str__
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the directory tree.

methods.name: _stringify_tree
methods.description: Recursively builds a print-friendly string of the directory and its children.
